CLASS 44 · POSITION & DIRECTION WORDS · CARD 1 OF 22

Above

Something above you is higher than you are. The balloon floats above her head, the book is held above his, the bird flies above them all. Look up right now — name one thing above you!

On the card

“Above” — shown five ways: Balloon above, Book above, Bird above, Hat above, Star above.

Try it today

Stand under a doorway and say "the frame is above me." Then hold your favorite toy above your head and freeze like a statue.

Keep going

Above is word 1 of 22 in the Position & Direction Words class. Print it for the fridge, then hop back to the class page for the next word on the shelf.
